build.reason: Autotools places the library target in src/lib, and public headers are under include. The old recipe retains a root archive path and compiles the target with only the root include path.

evidence.dependency_reason: The recipe fixes the incompatible compile and link paths.

input.reason: The entry passes each supplied byte buffer and its size to the reply parsers; there is no harness input filter.

evidence.dependency_reason: The parser accepts a byte buffer and length.

lifecycle.reason: The entry initializes and conditionally frees output pointers, but the supplied TXT parser body delegates to an unsupplied helper, so its full output and cleanup contract is unresolved.

evidence.dependency_reason: TXT parsing delegates its output behavior to an unsupplied helper.

control_flow.reason: The entry unconditionally calls each listed parser in sequence and then conditionally frees its result; no entry guard excludes a supplied parser.

evidence.dependency_reason: A and AAAA parsing pass the supplied buffer into their common DNS parser.

blockers.requirement: Link the fuzzer against the archive produced by the relocated Autotools library target.
blockers.target_route: build.sh runs buildconf, configure, and make all, then links ares_parse_reply_fuzzer against $SRC/c-ares/.libs/libcares.a.
blockers.failure_condition: The root Makefile delegates to src/lib, where libcares.la is built; the recipe's root .libs/libcares.a path is not that output.
blockers.alternative_paths: The in-tree test rules use src/lib/libcares.la, but the OSS-Fuzz link command is direct and has no fallback path.
